b:
Through the window
I glance for a moment

There she is,
one
in a thousand,

in the middle
of my
beloved ones

The moment my forefinger
touched her
I knew
she was the one for me

But there
in the bridal
market
a crowd was waiting
to steal her
away

Smashing all delay
I pressed
my cheek
to her
face,
"to claim her"

Her
fragrance
a royal intoxication

As I put
her paper body
and her black-and-white soul
safely
into my bag,

across from me,

another one.
I am smitten again
note: The beloved turns out to be a book, found in a bookshop window; the "bridal market" is a book fair.
